## Implementation (all `MODULES.md` repair sites completed)

| Module | What was implemented |
|---|---|
| `te/session.py` | Replay engine: separates *problem state* (c/d/paths/mode/rho), *algorithm state* (cache, `z`/`u`, barrier) and the *transport registry* (immutable proposals, receipts, checkpoints). Generation increments on every configure/restore and never rolls back; all 8 event handlers produce the exact response schemas. |
| `.../distributed/worker.py` | The ρ-scaled worker objective solved by an **exact active-set QP method** (each iteration solves one small dense KKT system), so `G+λ ≥ 0` and `f = D` hold to machine precision; reports raw worker **totals** and per-commodity potentials (multipliers); lists every unroutable commodity. |
| `.../communication/partial_barrier.py` | Freshness set, acceptance ages, missing/stale blockers, progress conditions, snapshot/restore. |
| `.../distributed/coordinator.py` | `V = αX + (1−α)z₀ + u₀`, analytic projection (route: ceiling solving `ρ·Σ(V−h)₊ = 1`; admit: `h=1`), pressure `t = ρ(V−z)`, dual `u = u₀+αX+(1−α)z₀−z`, retune preserving `ρ·u`. |
| `sub_algorithms/admm.py`, `pdlp_mlu.py`, `simplex_projection.py`, `pgd.py` | Consensus bias/scaled dual, dependency-free controller projection, mass/active-mask projections, capacity-scaled sharing gradient. |
| `path_providers/base.py`, `sparse_ops.py` | Stable-slot COO provider (fixed the broken `update_path`, sparse holes, null slots) and kernels separating worker totals, normalised utilisation and means. |

- bias weighted by `1/c²` instead of `1/c` (broke the `f = D` identity), path multiplicities ignored in the Hessian, a "best iterate" rule masking the converged admit solution, the penalty not restored from checkpoints, division by zero on withdrawn edges.

## Verification harness (`/workspace/dev`, outside the submission)
- An **independent re-implementation** of the replay semantics re-checking every reported number (worker + controller certificates, dispositions, checkpoint semantics) — 1000+ randomized requests pass.
- 93 illegal-input checks; hand-written scenarios; 23,600 solver instances verified against KKT/`f=D`; mutation fuzzing (no crashes, always valid JSON); max request replays in **0.4 s** (limits 180 s wall / 120 s CPU); tree bounds 26 files / 83 KB (limits 128 / 2 MiB).
